batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved CamScanner scan of the JU D Unit 2014-2015 paper whose printed header box reads 'SET CODE: 13/14', in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2014-2015-set6.pdf (6 pp.). ⚠ LISTING MISMATCH: the Drive listing/file is labelled 'Set-6' but the paper's own printed set code is 13/14 (a merged pair code, as also printed for the sibling banks সেট ১/২ and সেট ৩/৪); the printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2014-2015-set13-14. The compilation prints most questions with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ ক/খ/গ/ঘ' key (Bangla letters, mapped to option positions a–d). No subject headings are printed: subjects were assigned by content; Botany/Zoology are carried as subject Biology with the split in topic and one continuous numbering in printed order. ব্যাখ্যা/key boxes that spill to the top of the next column or page are documented in the question's extractionNote; appearances keep the question's own page. Handwritten reader marks (incl. a circled '4' on p.1 of the Set-4 file) are not keys. Counts: 80 questions (Biology 40, Chemistry 24, IQ 5, Bangla 4, English 4, General Mathematics 3); keyed 73, keyless 7, dispositions 0, dual keys 0. See EXTRACTION_NOTES_D1415B.md. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit 2014-2015 question paper, printed SET CODE 13/14 — compiler-solved scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive PDF; listed as Set-6)
sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint: most questions are followed by a ব্যাখ্যা frame and a boxed উত্তরঃ key (Bangla letters ক/খ/গ/ঘ). Aggregator footers 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com' / 'Visit www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper. Two-column layout; options labelled (ক)–(ঘ), a few English items (a)–(d). Downloaded earlier in this project into sources/pdfs2/; contents verified by SHA-256 against the archived file at transcription time.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৪-২০১৫; জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; D-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ; সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট; পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০; প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে; প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না; SET CODE: 13/14.
